caption: The video captures a stainless steel pot resting on crumpled aluminum foil, its interior holding a shallow pool of pale yellowish liquid. A large, opaque white mass sits in the liquid, accompanied by a smaller white patch to the left. A metal spoon rests with its bowl near the lower side, and a thin dark rod leans diagonally against the rim. Throughout the clip the white mass slowly changes shape, its irregular edges shifting and appearing slightly smoother and more rounded. The smaller patch likewise deforms, with tiny surface bubbles appearing and shifting across it. The spoon and the dark rod remain essentially stationary, with no visible stirring motion. The overall liquid level and foil background appear broadly unchanged, and the camera remains largely fixed on this ongoing, gradual transformation.
relations: The large white mass in the liquid gradually deforms, its irregular edges shifting toward smoother, rounded contours.
The smaller white patch deforms concurrently, with tiny surface bubbles emerging and shifting across its changing surface.
The stationary spoon and dark rod maintain their positions, resting in the liquid without causing visible stirring.
The surrounding liquid level and foil background persist broadly unchanged while the white masses undergo gradual shape transformation.
